mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ123. Fires four Ki bullets; a missed blast can reverse after about one second and track the opponent from behind. At red health, the attack uses eight blasts. Current references report 5% total damage for the normal four-blast version and 15% for the red-health version; exact frame/hitbox data remains unresolved.
